sentences.en: I happened to witness the bullying in the corridor.
sentences.zh: 我在走廊里恰好目睹了那场欺凌。

sentences.en: I don't approve of the way he bullies others.
sentences.zh: 我不赞成他欺负别人的方式。

sentences.en: It's time to put a stop to workplace bullying.
sentences.zh: 是时候停止职场上的欺凌了。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：bull（公牛）+y（表行为）→像公牛一样吓唬别人→恐吓
